Resolves #21122

Portal Markdown views no longer emit relative links that resolve against `/apps/portal/` and 404. After the engine's `rewriteLinks()` pass, the four views hand every relative href it leaves alone to `rewriteRepoLinks()` in `apps/portal/Util.mjs`: a `learn/` page opens its Portal route, any other repository file opens on GitHub in a new tab. Bodies written on GitHub (tickets, pull requests, discussions) resolve from the repository root and accept GitHub's own `../blob/<ref>/` form. Learn guides, blog posts and release notes resolve from their file's folder, read off the path they are fetched from, so a training-deck page resolves from its own folder too. A path above the repository root, or whose first segment is no top-level entry, stays as authored.

Evidence: L2 (spec-driven: each view's real `rewriteLinks` prototype runs after the engine's pass; the same view tests fail on `origin/dev`) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3 cover what the views emit, checked by unit tests). No residuals; the live render and the Search Console recrawl are under Post-Merge Validation.

Covers tickets, pull requests and discussions (`ai/…#L595`, `../blob/dev/…`, `learn/…md`), release notes, a learn guide plus a training-deck page, and a blog post. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **`ai/` opens in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`.** neo has had no `ai/` folder since the split, so the ticket's `neomjs/neo/blob/dev/ai/…` URL is a GitHub 404. A link pinned to a commit stays in neo, where that commit holds it.
- **`../blob/<ref>/` and `../tree/<ref>/` keep their ref and kind.** The ticket normalizes to `blob/dev`; keeping the ref means a SHA-pinned line link keeps its lines.
- **A `../` path that climbs above the repository root stays as authored.** The ticket asked to normalize these. The corpus holds 40 such links (e.g. `../../agentos/NeuralLink.md`), and no rule maps them without guessing the folder they were written in. The ticket's two GSC examples of this class (`/apps/decisions/0027-…`, `/apps/agentos/IdentityFirewall.md`) have no relative source left in `learn/` or the corpus: every link to those files is an absolute GitHub URL now, so those 404s age out on recrawl.
- **A file that moved since its link was written gets GitHub's 404, not ours.** Example: `test/playwright/unit/ai/…`, now in the Brain. Only `ai/` moved as a whole top-level folder; a per-file rename map is out of scope.
- **New tabs get `target="_blank"` without `rel="noopener"`.** That is the form `Markdown.mjs` uses for its external ticket links, and browsers imply `noopener` for `_blank`.
- **`rewriteRepoLinks(html, filePath)` takes the file's path, not its folder.** It resolves a path the way `resolveContentId()` treats a record id: the last segment names a file.
- **`getSearchParams()` JSDoc now says `@returns {Object}`.** It said `{Function}`.

## Test Evidence

- **Red-first.** I ran the five view tests verbatim against the views at `origin/dev` `2404340dfa`: 5/5 fail, each receiving the raw relative hrefs (`ai/services/knowledge-base/VectorService.mjs#L595`, `../../src/Neo.mjs`, …). The engine's in-root routes already match there.
- **Relative-href census** (read-only script; `github-content-sync` at `46f22796`, Brain `dev`):
  - `learn/`: 165 files, 16 repository-file links, all resolving in neo.
  - Corpus: 20,761 issue, pull request and discussion files, about 300 relative repository links. 173 point into `ai/`; 136 of those resolve in the Brain at `dev`.
  - Release notes: none, in the 2 tracked files and the 172 corpus releases.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After the Portal deploy, #17343 in the tickets view links its five `VectorService.mjs` references to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`. The `src/` links in `#/learn/guides/datahandling/Grids` open on GitHub.
- [ ] Search Console: run "Validate fix" on the `Not found (404)` group once the `/apps/portal/ai/…` examples are recrawled.
